neighbours.label: The opinion verbs considered, regarded and consider in 'is considered by most', 'regarded as'; 'considered buying' and plain descriptions stay lower.
fire: The Grand Canyon is considered by most a natural wonder.
The new district is considered by many a failure.
Falling birth rates are regarded as a threat.
This treatment is widely regarded as safe.
Biologists consider all domestic dogs one species.
Her first novel is considered a landmark of the genre.
Coal is still regarded as a cheap fuel.
Historians consider the treaty a turning point.
quiet: The Grand Canyon is located in northern Arizona.
The new district is served by two bus lines.
Falling birth rates are reported each year.
This treatment is given twice a week.
Biologists counted all the dogs in the village.
Her first novel is printed in small type.
Coal is still shipped by rail.
Historians considered buying the old map.

predictions: 7/8 fire, 0-1 near miss. 'He considered buying a car' reached 0.27, so the buying near miss may rise.
notes: Probes: considered 0.49-0.93, regarded 0.35-0.79, consider 0.61; 'considered buying' 0.27, plain under 0.03.
